lead.headline: Claim Gordon before 01:00 — and Achane is still starting
lead.deck: Out for the season and still in an RB slot. Tuten goes in; Gordon is tonight's claim.
lead.body: De'Von Achane tore his ACL and is out for the season, and at 18:18 he is still in AVIATO's starting lineup. That's why ESPN has you at 114.0 against Aye-Aye's 125.2. Start Bhayshul Tuten there and the lineup reaches 126.7. Claims process at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City, overnight. Ollie Gordon II, who took Miami's backfield on Sunday, is the one claim worth making, with Achane as the drop, and AVIATO is first in the order. Three starters are questionable and none has practised: Josh Allen (knee contusion, Chao expects no missed time), Justin Jefferson (ankle, 'got close' to playing last Sunday) and Jalen Coker (quad, Bryce Young having his own knee imaged). Both WR fallbacks lock before Sunday's inactives, so Friday's report decides Jefferson. Week 3 was lost 103.8 to 140.6; the best lineup this roster had scored 137.9, and three of the gaps were injury exits.

wire.headline: One claim tonight: Gordon for Achane
wire.deck: The screen's list was researched in full. Gordon is the claim. Addison, Braelon Allen and Meyers are watches with a condition; everyone else is a pass, mostly for want of a seat.

3918298.deck: Knee contusion; every report says he plays.
3918298.reason: Chao: 'hurt, not injured'; NE allows the 28th-most to QBs
3918298.availability: QUESTIONABLE — left-knee contusion from a 4th-quarter hit vs LAC; Dr. David Chao: no significant MCL injury, 'hurt, not injured', no missed time expected (SI, 29 Sep). The coach said missing New England was not a risk (CBS, 28 Sep). First Bills practice report is Wednesday
3918298.role: 26–31 pass attempts and 6–14 carries a week; the only quarterback on the roster
3918298.checked: SI/Chao 29 Sep; CBS 28 Sep; Bills have not practised yet (Wed is the first report)

vsProjection.text: Chao expects no missed time; ESPN still has him QB1.

3918298.logic: Projected 22.5, QB1. No bench QB, so there is no swap to make; if he's ruled out, the plan is a free-agent Kyler Murray for Monangai. Priced: the questionable tag is in the number. What would change it: a DNP Wednesday and Thursday.

vsProjection.text: ESPN has him questionable and still projects him as a WR1.
